about: The kinds registry's own cases: the file the contract examples run through parseContractText, with every refusal and the line it was raised, in the set's fixture-cases style. Every case at contract version 1 carries `contract: 1` on its first line; the refusals about the version itself name the version.

cases.name: the set-out stages and kinds
cases.text:
contract: 1
stages:
  - id: idea
  - id: requirements
  - id: design
  - id: build
  - id: verify
  - id: release
  - id: operate
kinds:
  - name: source
    prefix: S
    folder: docs/sources
    stage: idea
    hint: have the first conversation with a customer, write it down
  - name: hypothesis
    prefix: H
    folder: docs/hypotheses
    stage: idea
    hint: turn a source into one checkable sentence
  - name: product requirement
    prefix: FR
    folder: docs/requirements
    stage: requirements
    hint: write what the product does, one requirement at a time
  - name: decision
    prefix: D
    folder: docs/decisions
    stage: design
    hint: record the choice between the options on the table
